تبتهجون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَهِجُونَ (tabtahijūna) /tab.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# تُبْتَهَجُونَ (tubtahajūna) /tub.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
